title: ChatGPT Perpetuates Gender Bias in Machine Translation and Ignores Non-Gendered Pronouns: Findings across Bengali and Five other Low-Resource Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Translating sentences with gender-neutral pronouns from Bengali and five other low-resource languages into English to observe whether the model assigns 'he' or 'she' based on occupational and action-based stereotypes. The study also analyzes the assignment of respectful versus standard pronouns in English-to-Bengali translations based on the subject's gender.

Evaluating the model's ability to correctly translate the English gender-neutral singular pronoun 'they' into Bengali, measuring instances where the model incorrectly outputs grammatically invalid collective pronouns instead of preserving non-binary singular pronouns.
